description: 量化研究流水线阶段 1：使用 AlphaLab DataEngine 从本地数据源读取股票池、行情与基本面数据，并写入一次运行目录。

strategy_path.description: 策略 YAML 路径；默认 alphalab/strategies/momentum.yaml

data_dir.description: AlphaLab data 目录；默认 E:/quant-framework/data

symbols.description: 可选股票代码列表；为空时从策略 universe 或 DataEngine universe 解析

universe.description: 可选股票池名称，默认 all

start_date.description: 起始日期 YYYY-MM-DD；为空时按 as_of_date 和 lookback_days 推导

end_date.description: 结束日期 YYYY-MM-DD；为空时使用 as_of_date/最新日期/今天

code:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import json
import pandas as pd

PROJECT = Path(r"E:\quant-framework")


def _records_json(df: pd.DataFrame, path: Path) -> None:
    out = df.copy()
    for col in out.columns:
        if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(out[col]):
            out[col] = out[col].dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(out.to_json(orient="records", force_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")


def run(input, context):
    import sys
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))
    from alphalab.dataio import create_default_engine
    from alphalab.strategy.config import StrategyConfig

    strategy_path = Path(input.get("strategy_path") or PROJECT / "alphalab" / "strategies" / "momentum.yaml")
    if not strategy_path.is_absolute():
        strategy_path = PROJECT / strategy_path
    data_dir = Path(input.get("data_dir") or PROJECT / "data")
    cfg = StrategyConfig.from_yaml(strategy_path)
    engine = create_default_engine(data_dir)

    symbols = [str(s).upper() for s in (input.get("symbols") or []) if str(s).strip()]
    universe = input.get("universe") or cfg.universe.pool or "all"
    if not symbols:
        symbols = list(cfg.universe.symbols) or engine.get_symbols(universe)

    latest = engine.get_latest_date()
    as_of_date = input.get("as_of_date") or input.get("end_date") or latest or datetime.today().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    end_date = input.get("end_date") or as_of_date
    lookback_days = int(input.get("lookback_days") or 120)
    start_date = input.get("start_date") or (pd.Timestamp(end_date) - pd.Timedelta(days=max(lookback_days * 2, lookback_days + 30))).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    fields = input.get("fields") or ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]

    run_id = input.get("run_id") or datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    run_dir = PROJECT / "data" / "app" / "pipeline_runs" / run_id
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    bars = engine.get_bars(symbols, start_date, end_date, strict=False, fields=fields)
    fundamental_names = [f.name for f in cfg.factors if f.source == "fundamental"]
    fundamentals = pd.DataFrame()
    if fundamental_names and symbols:
        year = pd.Timestamp(end_date).year
        fundamentals = engine.get_fundamentals(symbols, fundamental_names, f"{year - 3}q1", f"{year}q4", asof_date=end_date, strict=False)

    bars_path = run_dir / "bars.json"
    fundamentals_path = run_dir / "fundamentals.json"
    _records_json(bars, bars_path)
    _records_json(fundamentals, fundamentals_path)

    return {
        "stage": "DataEngine",
        "run_id": run_id,
        "run_dir": str(run_dir),
        "strategy_path": str(strategy_path),
        "data_dir": str(data_dir),
        "symbols": symbols,
        "bars_path": str(bars_path),
        "fundamentals_path": str(fundamentals_path),
        "counts": {"symbols": len(symbols), "bars": int(len(bars)), "fundamentals": int(len(fundamentals))},
        "providers": engine.providers(),
        "params": {"universe": universe, "start_date": start_date, "end_date": end_date, "as_of_date": as_of_date, "lookback_days": lookback_days, "fields": fields},
        "samples": {"bars": bars.head(5).astype(str).to_dict(orient="records"), "fundamentals": fundamentals.head(5).astype(str).to_dict(orient="records")},
    }
